name: ChatEntry drwaer duplicated
description:
1. Reported bug: the ChatEntry drawer was rendered twice, and tools/events didn't update in realtime — requiring close/reopen to see changes.
2. Root cause: `ChatEntry.vue` rendered a `<ChatEntryDrawer>` overlay while `ChatMessageList.vue` rendered its own inline events panel, both triggered by the same "Events & Tools" button.
3. The realtime issue came from `ChatMessageList` storing a one-time snapshot (`activeMessageData`) that never refreshed when new tool/lifecycle events arrived.
4. Fix: removed the duplicate drawer from `ChatEntry` (now uses an `eventsOpen` prop + emits `message`), and made `ChatMessageList` derive panel data live from the reactive `messages` prop via `activeEventsMessageKey`.
5. Files changed: `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` and `src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue`; `ChatEntryDrawer.vue` is now unused and can be deleted in a follow-up.

Let me give you the analysis and the fix. ## 1. Analysis & Pre-Thinking **Core Requirements** - The events/tools view is **rendered twice** at the same time (duplication). - Tools/events shown in that view **don't update while a message is still processing** — you must close and reopen to see the new entries. **Root cause** Two independent panels exist and both react to the same "Events & Tools" button: 1. `` rendered inside `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` (a `fixed` overlay), driven by a **local** `eventsOpen` flag. 2. An inline **Events Panel** rendered by `src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue` (left column), driven by `showEventsPanel` + `activeMessageData`. When the button is clicked, `ChatEntry.toggleEventsPanel()` does **both**: ```js this.eventsOpen = !this.eventsOpen // opens ChatEntryDrawer this.$emit('show-events', { ...snapshot... }) // opens ChatMessageList panel ``` → two panels appear (the duplication). The realtime bug comes from the ChatMessageList panel: it stores a **snapshot** of the events taken at the moment the button was clicked (`activeMessageData = eventData`). New tool/lifecycle events that arrive afterwards are never reflected, so you must close/reopen to re-snapshot. The `show-events` wiring only exists to feed this inline panel, which marks it as the intended, current design — `ChatEntryDrawer` is the redundant legacy overlay. **Strategic Approach** - Remove the redundant `ChatEntryDrawer` usage (and local `eventsOpen`) from `ChatEntry.vue`. - Turn `ChatEntry`'s events button into a pure toggle that emits the `message` and receives the open-state back via an `eventsOpen` prop. - Make `ChatMessageList`'s panel **live** by tracking the active message key (`activeEventsMessageKey`) and deriving the panel data from the reactive `messages` prop (a computed), instead of a one-time snapshot. **Dependencies & Risks** - `ChatEntry` is also used by `src/components/wall/ChatPreview.vue` (no `show-events` listener). The new prop defaults to `undefined` → falsy, safe. - `ChatEntryDrawer.vue` becomes unused (left in place, can be deleted later). - `ChatMessageList` handles `@show-events` internally; no other consumer is affected. **Target Files** - `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` — modify - `src/components/chat/ChatMessageList.vue` — modify ## 2. Minimum Changes Approach - **ChatEntry.vue** → delete import + `` block; add `eventsOpen` prop; remove local `eventsOpen` data; reduce `toggleEventsPanel` to emit `message`. - **ChatMessageList.vue** → compute panel data live from `messages` by active key; make the button a real toggle; close on chat change. ## 3. File changes, Code Block Formatting & Proposed Changes ```vue src/components/ChatEntry.vue ``` | File Path | Action | Component / Section | Change Description | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `import` | Removed the now-duplicated `ChatEntryDrawer` import. | | `src/components/ChatEntry.vue` | Modify | `
